payload.title: Float rounding in roundMoney() drops half-cents
payload.markdown:
# Postmortem: Float rounding in roundMoney() drops half-cents

## Summary
Since v0.4.0, amounts ending in exactly half a cent were rounded down, so tax and totals were one cent low on many orders.

## Impact
214 orders under-collected tax by $0.01, causing reconciliation mismatches with the payment provider.

## Root cause
Commit 'refactor: round prices consistently' centralised rounding in money.roundMoney but implemented it as Math.round(Number((amount / 100).toFixed(2)) * 100). Binary floats cannot represent values like 0.825, and toFixed(2) rounds the stored value 0.82499999… down.

## Evidence
- Reconciliation deltas are all -0.01 and begin at the v0.4.0 deploy
- git show of the refactor commit introduces toFixed(2) in roundMoney
- Reproduction test: tax 82 !== 83 for a 10.00 US order

## Fix
roundMoney now rounds the integer-cent amount directly with Math.round (half-up for positive amounts).

## How it was verified
Half-cent tests pass; the existing pricing and order tests still pass.

- Reproduction test `tests/fixsi/half-cent-rounding.test.js` failed before the fix and passes after it.
- Full suite: 32 passed, 0 failed (baseline: 30 passed). Pre-existing tests were not modified.
- Fix attempts: 1.

## Prevention
- Lint rule banning toFixed() and dollar floats in money code
- Property test comparing roundMoney with exact half-up rounding on random half-cent values

---
